name: Rods, shafts and rails
summary: Steel rods, shafts, rails and bars: axles, guide rods and rebar.
uses: Pry bars, stakes and frame parts
identify: Polished guide rods in printers, scanners and copiers; axles in mowers, prams and treadmills; rebar on building sites; drive shafts in washers and vehicles.
test: Roll it on a flat surface: a straight rod rolls evenly without wobble. Check bearing surfaces for rust pits.

decay.note: Lasts; polished rods rust if left damp.
